_note: Ability kits (docs/PLAN_ABILITY_KITS.md): a tactical, a passive and an ultimate each, named and numbered by us. RUNNER is JOLT's kit and MEDIC is TRIAGE's (abilities.json keeps those two's own numbers). The ultimate is a meter from 0 to 1: it fills with time alone in fullAfter seconds, and faster with damage dealt (perDamage a point of damage), and is spent whole. The genre's ultimates take two to four minutes by time alone; ours is two and a half, because our matches are shorter.
_runner: RUNNER: JOLT's dash as its tactical; its passive, SURE FOOTING, takes away the stun of a hard landing (movement.json fallstun); its ultimate, OVERDRIVE, is seconds of every move speed times speed, with JOLT's charges refilled at the start.
_medic: MEDIC: TRIAGE's faster heals as its passive; its tactical, PATCH, gives back health over seconds (not past full), every cooldown seconds; its ultimate, FIELD HEAL, gives health over seconds to you and every team or squad mate within radius metres of you, each page healing its own player.
